name: Layout Switcher
description:
Switch keyboard layouts (input sources) from the command line, scripts and custom shortcuts via D-Bus.

Select an exact keyboard language instead of cycling through them: bind a separate hotkey to each layout, or switch to English automatically from your own scripts. Works with XKB layouts and IBus input methods.

D-Bus API: SetLayout, GetCurrentLayout, ListLayouts. Usage examples for gdbus, busctl and Python are in the README.
